description: Return the full details of one AkulaCyber product, with a photo attached as an image and a cart_url that opens the store cart with one piece of it; price and stock are read live on every call. Use it when the user names one product or after akulacyber_search_products; for two or more KVMs side by side use akulacyber_compare_kvms, and for several products or quantities in one cart akulacyber_create_cart_link. Pass product as the slug from search results, the model or part number, or the GTIN; lang sets the language of the texts and of the page URL. An unknown product returns an error listing every valid slug.

lang.description: Language of the texts and page URLs in the answer: uk (Ukrainian, the default), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language the user writes in.

product.description: One product: a slug from search results (gl-rm1), a model or part number (GL-RM1, GL-ATXPC) or a 13-digit GTIN; case does not matter.

name: akulacyber_get_product
title: Get AkulaCyber product details
